case.title: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.. Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red. Need: 15900 pc a year. Category goal: quality first: defects and late deliveries cost more than a few cents of price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 58 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200011. Must-haves: ppm_commitment <= 1500. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain flexible and look forward to hearing from you soon so we can start building a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

You wrote that you are eager to prove yourselves as a long-term partner, and the options below are built for exactly that, with a clear quality commitment and a firm price you can plan around.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 63.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 1,500 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 39.85.
Option B: quality commitment 800 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.18.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.41.

Option A is the package we can approve. It sets a quality commitment that is realistic for a foundry to hold, and it gives you a clean price with no chargebacks, so your work with us stays predictable.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

We would be glad to settle this with you directly.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net, and our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351.

Our current offer is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. We can agree to your Option A with the 1500 ppm and 0 EUR chargeback. We can come down to 46.00 EUR for this, but we really need you to pay your invoices on time. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 1500 ppm: €46.00 per unit, a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

You wrote that faster payment would help you more than anything. Our options do not change the payment term, so I will not promise anything there; what they give you is a clear quality commitment and a firm unit price you can plan around.

We have taken note that you accepted our delivery and price history points, and we appreciate it. That lets us stay with the line we proposed rather than reopen it.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 150.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.52.
Option B: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.48.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 300.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.57.

Option A is the package we can approve: it keeps the quality commitment you can work to, with a chargeback on complaints that is moderate, and a unit price that sits between the other two.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for moving your price; we see the effort to get closer, and your wish to lock this in is clear to us.

Our options still leave the payment term as it is, so I will not promise anything there.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 44.49.
Option B: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 300.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 44.58.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 150.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 44.54.

Option A is the package we can approve: it takes the chargeback risk off your side entirely and rests on a quality level you have already put forward. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Hello,
thank you for your mail, we are very happy to hear from you!
this is our last price, take it or leave it.
Our terms: a price of €45.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.
To be fully transparent with you:
Thanks for the small bump in price, but as I keep saying, without faster payment we just can't drop any further.
We are sticking to 45.50 EUR for Option A, and this is our final offer.
Let's just lock this in and get the order moving!
We are a competitive and flexible partner.
We really want this business - let's make it happen!
Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
